description: This file is a script for benchmarking and comparing CLI startup times and resource usage against a baseline. It parses command-line arguments, loads benchmark report data, performs comparisons, and outputs results. It is part of a testing or benchmarking suite for a JavaScript project.

methods.name: formatMs
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as milliseconds with one decimal place, e.g., '123.4ms'.

methods.name: formatMb
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as megabytes with one decimal place, e.g., '56.7MB'.

methods.name: resolveCurrentReportPath
methods.description: Determines the path to the current benchmark report, generating it if necessary by running a benchmark.

methods.name: indexCases
methods.description: Indexes report cases by their ID for easy lookup.
